claims.claim: Zapier Free is $0/month with 100 tasks per month and Professional starts at $19.99/month on the official pricing page.
Zapier states that it connects to 9,000+ apps.
n8n Starter is 20 euros per month when billed annually and includes 2,500 workflow executions with unlimited steps.
n8n publishes a self-hosted Community Edition and charges cloud plans by workflow executions rather than per step.
Activepieces Standard is free for 10 active flows and then $5 per active flow per month, with unlimited runs and AI agents included.
Relevance AI Free includes 200 Actions per month, while Pro starts at $19 per month billed annually and includes 2,500 Actions per month plus Vendor Credits.
G2 reviewers praise n8n flexibility, integrations, and self-hosting while noting a learning curve for users unfamiliar with coding or APIs.
G2 reviewers praise Activepieces usability and affordability while noting fewer integrations than established competitors.
G2 and Capterra review trends praise Zapier integrations, templates, and ease of setup while noting that multi-step or high-volume usage can increase cost.
G2 and independent review trends praise Relevance AI agent flexibility and model/tool combinations while raising questions about Actions and external model cost predictability.
